units.source_text: 阿光觉得，只有靖国神社院内人声嘈杂，简直像发狂了一样。

en.t: Aguang felt that only the grounds of Yasukuni Shrine were noisy with human voices, almost as if they had gone mad.

units.source_text: 相形之下，想来院外该是悄然无声的。

en.t: By contrast, he imagined that outside the shrine grounds it must have been utterly silent.

units.source_text: 无数的人头活像影子戏，无声无息地移动着。

en.t: Countless heads moved soundlessly, just like figures in a shadow play.
